description: Every published signal: slug, title, date, mechanism, geography codes, series keys with whether their values are redistributable, counts of organisations and hypotheses, the edition title, a summary of the reviewed dossier (verdict, counts, contradicted links) and the URLs to read it. Each signal has its place in the classification tree (domain › sector › chain); the tree itself, with the sectors not covered yet, comes back as taxonomy. Optional filters: q (text in title or slug), mechanism, geography (ISO code), domain and filiere (the sector id; ids from the tree).
name: list_signals
title: List the published signals
